title: Diaphragm Call Frame Set (single / double / template)
description: Three flat horseshoe frames (single-reed, double-reed, with 3 sizes) plus a latex cutting template. You supply the thin latex film; the frame holds it taut like a diaphragm call.
use: Hobby and acoustics experiment, e.g. turkey-style yelp practice. Adults only for mouth use; wash well, replace regularly.
material: PETG, 0.12 mm layers, 100% infill for the frames.
assembly: 1. Cut a latex / dental-dam strip using the template ring as a size guide.
2. Stretch the film across the open front of the frame, tape the edges to the frame legs.
3. Trim the film so one thin edge floats free over the opening - that edge is the vibrating reed.
fit_notes: Single-piece frames, no press-fit. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune. Hygiene: wash printed parts well; porous plastic.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
